# Wrong Turn, Best View

## The Bookshop in the Rain

It began with two hands reaching for the same travel book while rain traced the window. They talked until closing, discovering that an ordinary detour could become the start of everything.

## Two Cities and One Small Home

Seven years carried them through two cities and into a first tiny apartment. The rooms were modest, but the life inside them kept expanding—especially after a sock-stealing corgi arrived and claimed the softest corners.

## The View They Kept

Plans still went sideways. Breakfast still occasionally became a smoke-alarm serenade. Each time, they returned to the phrase that had become their compass: wrong turn, best view. Their keepsake was never a perfect route; it was the joy of finding the view together.
